target: Series verification gate for the CostProfile F series after the F-FULLSUITE-REPAIR (PR #709) and INDEX-status correction (PR #710) landed on origin/main. Re-runs the full RTE test suite, the bounded-lane `--print-config` probe (Phase A step A2, --cost-profile value-default), a focused OpenRouter route-readiness probe, and a clean-shell CLI import probe under `PYTHONPATH=src`. Produces a single PROOF bundle that signs off the CostProfile F series as VERIFIED, NOT_VERIFIED, or BLOCKED. This is the series-final gate referenced by the F-FULLSUITE-REPAIR proof bundle's `follow_up_packets` list.
invariants: Verification only. Do not modify any runtime code, tests, model routing, model_map, or test fixtures in this packet.
Do NOT re-issue or re-execute the F-FULLSUITE-REPAIR repair work. This packet consumes the repair as evidence and answers the series-verification question.

Do NOT touch Cluster D / TP-RTE-WALKER-006 work. Cluster D prescan failures remain deferred via strict xfail markers per the repair packet; any XPASS on those markers counts as a series-gate FAILURE, not a deferral.
Do NOT run live provider calls. Do NOT run live extraction (`--execute`). RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1 stays set for every test/probe step.

All required verification pipelines (pytest|tee, run_extraction_v5.py|tee) MUST be wrapped with `bash -o pipefail` so upstream non-zero exits surface. Masking is prohibited; no `|| true` is permitted on a required gate.
PROOF.json `status_scope` MUST be `series_gate` — not the repair packet's `repair_gate_only_not_series_gate`. This packet IS the series gate; mislabeling it strips the verdict of meaning.

Test counts are a floor, not equality. Repair gate reported 1114 passed / 9 xfailed at `bab75c949`; PR #710 was docs-only so the suite should be unchanged. Required: ≥1114 passed, deferred-state (xfailed + skipped) ≥9, failed == 0, xpassed == 0. The deferred-state floor accommodates env-driven XFAIL ↔ SKIPPED transitions only when an audit-only test such as `test_fa_8_high_1_preflight_probe.py` skips because `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` is absent, the total deferred-state count remains equivalent, failed == 0, and xpassed == 0. Report actual xfailed and skipped counts separately in PROOF.json, document any env-driven classification drift, and verify the deferred-state total against the repair-gate baseline.

Verdict discriminator: all 5 gates PASS + counts ≥ floor + failed == 0 + xpassed == 0 + status_scope=series_gate → VERIFIED. Any gate FAIL (test failure, XPASS, import error, missing top-level `cost_profile` in print-config, OpenRouter probe failure) → NOT_VERIFIED (still create the PR with the negative result for audit). Environmental block (worktree creation fails, pytest hangs past timeout, etc.) → BLOCKED (no PR).
If verification fails, file a follow-up TP rather than 'fixing in place' — preserves the audit-trail boundary between repair packets and the verification gate.

PAL codereview + precommit MUST run on the staged diff. If specific PAL calls fail (model availability, sandbox limitations), record SKIPPED-with-reason in PROOF and omit the missing file from `sha256sums.txt` (do not fabricate transcripts).
Preserve Dopemux split authority boundaries per AGENTS.md §6.

pr.title: test(rte): verify costprofile f repair
pr.body:
## Summary
- Series-final verification gate for the RTE CostProfile F series after PR #709 (F-FULLSUITE-REPAIR) and PR #710 (INDEX status correction).
- Re-runs the full RTE test suite + bounded-lane `--print-config` probe + focused OpenRouter route-readiness probe + clean-shell CLI import probe, all under RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1.
- Captures pal/planner + pal/codereview + pal/precommit transcripts (or SKIPPED-with-reason markers) on the verification diff.
- Produces SERIES_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md and PROOF.json attesting the series verdict (VERIFIED / NOT_VERIFIED / BLOCKED).

## Scope
Verification-only. No runtime, test, model-routing, or model_map changes. No live provider calls. No live extraction. No Cluster D / TP-RTE-WALKER-006 work. The PROOF bundle is the deliverable.

## Validation
Full RTE suite returns exit 0 with ≥1114 passed, deferred-state count xfailed + skipped ≥ 9, failed == 0, and xpassed == 0; `--print-config` emits a top-level `cost_profile` field; OpenRouter route-readiness probe passes under RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1; `PYTHONPATH=src python -c "import dopemux.cli"` succeeds; pal/planner records the verification-only execution plan; pal/codereview reports no CRITICAL findings on the verification diff; pal/precommit returns SAFE TO COMMIT or only-info-level findings.

## NOT_RUN
- Live LLM/provider calls.
- `--execute` bounded lane.
- Cluster D / TP-RTE-WALKER-006 prescan repair (still deferred via strict xfail markers).
- Cross-pipeline integration with the v3-pipeline (separate authority).

## Residual Risks / UNKNOWNs
- The bounded-lane probe verifies `--print-config` resolves the profile but does not exercise live provider routing. Operator must still gate the first `--execute` run with `--max-cost-usd`.
- PAL transcripts depend on PAL model availability at execution time; SKIPPED-with-reason is acceptable and recorded in PROOF.
- Cluster D xfail markers carry strict=True; a future code change that incidentally fixes a Walker-006 case will surface as XPASS-strict and require an explicit follow-up.

@codex review

steps.task: Preflight (post-#709, post-#710 series-gate ancestry). Codex MUST verify, on origin/main as of execution time, that ALL of the following hold before branching: (1) PR #709 (F-FULLSUITE-REPAIR) is merged and both its head SHA and merge commit are ancestors of the captured base SHA; (2) PR #710 (INDEX status correction) is merged and both its head SHA and merge commit are ancestors of the captured base SHA; (3) proof/rte-cost-profile-redesign/TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-F-FULLSUITE-REPAIR-001/PROOF.json is present on the captured base SHA, parses as JSON, declares `status_scope: repair_gate_only_not_series_gate`, references `TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-F-VERIFY-002` as a follow-up packet, and records `live_provider_calls: NOT_RUN` plus `live_extraction: NOT_RUN`; (4) proof/rte-cost-profile-redesign/TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-F-FULLSUITE-REPAIR-001/REPAIR_DECISIONS.md is present on the captured base SHA; (5) task-packets/INDEX.md on the captured base SHA contains a TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-F-FULLSUITE-REPAIR-001 row marked `Merged (PR #709)` (or repo-equivalent merged status); (6) the captured immutable origin/main SHA is recorded and reused as the explicit branch base (do NOT branch from a local stale main or a later moving origin/main ref). STOP CONDITIONS — abort execution and surface to operator if ANY of: (a) origin/main cannot be fetched; (b) PR #709 is not merged; (c) PR #710 is not merged; (d) gh cannot return required PR state, head SHA, or merge commit fields; (e) PR #709/#710 head SHA is not an ancestor of the captured base SHA; (f) PR #709/#710 merge commit is not an ancestor of the captured base SHA; (g) repair packet row is missing the `Merged (PR #709)` marker; (h) repair PROOF.json is missing or invalid; (i) repair PROOF.json claims series-verified status (status_scope ≠ repair_gate_only_not_series_gate); (j) local checkout is dirty with tracked changes; (k) origin/main changes after capture and before worktree creation unless the operator explicitly accepts the newer base.
commands: BASE_SHA="$(cat /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_BASE_SHA.txt)" && PR709_HEAD="$(gh pr view 709 --json headRefOid -q .headRefOid)" && test -n "$PR709_HEAD" && git merge-base --is-ancestor "$PR709_HEAD" "$BASE_SHA"
BASE_SHA="$(cat /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_BASE_SHA.txt)" && PR710_HEAD="$(gh pr view 710 --json headRefOid -q .headRefOid)" && test -n "$PR710_HEAD" && git merge-base --is-ancestor "$PR710_HEAD" "$BASE_SHA"

BASE_SHA="$(cat /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_BASE_SHA.txt)" && PR709_MERGE="$(gh pr view 709 --json mergeCommit -q .mergeCommit.oid)" && test -n "$PR709_MERGE" && git merge-base --is-ancestor "$PR709_MERGE" "$BASE_SHA"

BASE_SHA="$(cat /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_BASE_SHA.txt)" && PR710_MERGE="$(gh pr view 710 --json mergeCommit -q .mergeCommit.oid)" && test -n "$PR710_MERGE" && git merge-base --is-ancestor "$PR710_MERGE" "$BASE_SHA"
validation: Captured base SHA persisted to /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_BASE_SHA.txt.

Tracked dirty state check is fail-closed: /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_TRACKED_STATUS_BEFORE.txt must be empty, `git diff --quiet` must pass, and `git diff --cached --quiet` must pass. Untracked artifacts are intentionally ignored.
PR #709 state == MERGED and both headRefOid + mergeCommit.oid are ancestors of the captured base SHA.
PR #710 state == MERGED and both headRefOid + mergeCommit.oid are ancestors of the captured base SHA.
INDEX row for F-FULLSUITE-REPAIR-001 is read from the captured base SHA and contains `Merged (PR #709)` (or repo-equivalent).

Repair PROOF.json is read from the captured base SHA and parses, status_scope == `repair_gate_only_not_series_gate`, lists `TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-F-VERIFY-002` in follow-up packets, records live calls + extraction as NOT_RUN.
REPAIR_DECISIONS.md readable from the captured base SHA.
Local checkout has no dirty tracked changes.

steps.task: Create fresh worktree at /private/tmp/dopemux-f-verify-002 on a new branch `codex/rte-costprofile-f-verify-002` rooted at the captured base SHA from /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_BASE_SHA.txt. Do not reuse an existing random worktree. STOP if worktree HEAD does not equal the captured base SHA. STOP if `git rev-parse origin/main` no longer equals the captured base SHA immediately before worktree creation unless the operator explicitly accepts the newer base.
commands: cd /private/tmp/dopemux-f-verify-002 && if [ -s /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_WORKTREE_TRACKED_STATUS.txt ]; then cat /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_WORKTREE_TRACKED_STATUS.txt; exit 1; fi

cd /private/tmp/dopemux-f-verify-002 && BASE_SHA="$(cat /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_BASE_SHA.txt)" && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$BASE_SHA" && git branch --show-current && git rev-parse HEAD && git status --short
validation: Worktree branch == `codex/rte-costprofile-f-verify-002`.
Worktree HEAD == captured base SHA from /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_BASE_SHA.txt.
origin/main did not change between base capture and worktree creation, unless the operator explicitly accepted a newer base.
Fresh worktree tracked dirty state check is fail-closed: /tmp/F_VERIFY_002_WORKTREE_TRACKED_STATUS.txt must be empty. Untracked artifacts are intentionally ignored.
Worktree tracked status is clean before edits.

steps.task: Gate 1 — Repair proof intake (formal). Parse PR #709 PROOF.json fetched in S1 and assert the contract: status == VERIFIED, status_scope == repair_gate_only_not_series_gate, follow_up_packets contains TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-F-VERIFY-002, and the NOT_RUN ledger explicitly lists live_provider_calls and live_extraction.
validation: All four assertions pass against /tmp/F_REPAIR_PROOF.json.
Repair proof's NOT_RUN bucket includes both live_provider_calls and live_extraction.

steps.task: Gate 2 — Full RTE suite. Run the full RTE test suite under the same safe/local constraints used by the repair proof (RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1, PYTHONPATH=services/repo-truth-extractor). Capture stdout/stderr to pytest_full_run.txt via `bash -o pipefail` so a non-zero pytest exit surfaces past the tee pipeline.
commands: bash -o pipefail -c 'RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1 PYTHONPATH=services/repo-truth-extractor python -m pytest services/repo-truth-extractor/tests --tb=short -v 2>&1 | tee proof/rte-cost-profile-redesign/TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-F-VERIFY-002/pytest_full_run.txt'
validation: pytest exit code 0 (preserved under bash -o pipefail).
No failed tests.
No XPASS events (Cluster D strict xfails must remain expected; an unintended pass is a series-gate FAILURE).

Totals: ≥1114 passed, deferred-state count xfailed + skipped >= 9, failed == 0, xpassed == 0. The env-driven `test_fa_8_high_1_preflight_probe.py` XFAIL-to-SKIPPED difference is acceptable only when it skips because `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` is absent, the deferred-state total remains equivalent, failed == 0, and xpassed == 0. Report actual xfailed and skipped counts in PROOF.json regardless.

steps.task: Gate 3 — Bounded print-config probe. Run `run_extraction_v5.py --phase A --step A2 --cost-profile value-default --print-config` (no `--execute`). Capture output via `bash -o pipefail` so a non-zero exit surfaces past the tee pipeline. Verify the resolved config includes a top-level `cost_profile` field, retains legacy routing fields for compatibility, and that no live provider call or live extraction took place.
commands: bash -o pipefail -c 'RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1 PYTHONPATH=services/repo-truth-extractor python services/repo-truth-extractor/run_extraction_v5.py --phase A --step A2 --run-id f_verify_002_print_config --output-root /tmp/rte-f-verify-002-print-config --cost-profile value-default --print-config 2>&1 | tee proof/rte-cost-profile-redesign/TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-F-VERIFY-002/bounded_lane_print_config.txt'
validation: Probe exits 0.
Output contains a top-level `cost_profile` field.
Legacy routing fields remain present for compatibility.
No live provider call ran (verified by RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1 + absence of --execute).
No live extraction ran.

steps.task: Gate 4 — Route readiness / OpenRouter residual probe. Run the focused residual tests that exercise Phase D provider preflight on OpenRouter 402 and provider-preflight-required-when-cost-routes-include-openrouter. Capture output via `bash -o pipefail` so a non-zero exit surfaces past the tee pipeline.
commands: bash -o pipefail -c 'RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1 PYTHONPATH=services/repo-truth-extractor python -m pytest -q -vv -p no:cacheprovider services/repo-truth-extractor/tests/test_provider_preflight_openrouter.py::test_phase_d_provider_preflight_blocks_on_openrouter_402 services/repo-truth-extractor/tests/test_provider_preflight_openrouter.py::test_phase_d_provider_preflight_is_required_when_cost_routes_include_openrouter | tee proof/rte-cost-profile-redesign/TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-F-VERIFY-002/route_readiness_probe.txt'
validation: Both focused tests pass.
Probe exits 0 under bash -o pipefail.
Probe runs with RTE_DISABLE_LIVE_LLM_IN_TESTS=1.

steps.task: Gate 5 — CLI import probe. Verify `dopemux.cli` imports cleanly under `PYTHONPATH=src` in a fresh shell (this repo uses an `src/` layout; the package is not installed at execution time, so a bare `python -c "import dopemux.cli"` without PYTHONPATH is invalid as a gate).
commands: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'import dopemux.cli' && echo 'OK: dopemux.cli imports cleanly under PYTHONPATH=src'
validation: Import succeeds with exit 0.

steps.task: Run pal/codereview on the staged verification diff (this packet's changes only — proof bundle + INDEX update + packet JSON). Capture transcript. Resolve every CRITICAL finding before proceeding to S9.
validation: pal/codereview transcript captured to pal_codereview.txt, OR a SKIPPED-with-reason marker captured to the same file naming the missing model/sandbox limitation.
0 CRITICAL findings remain (or SKIPPED documented).

steps.task: Run pal/precommit on the verification branch. Capture transcript. Must return SAFE TO COMMIT or only-info-level findings.
validation: pal/precommit transcript captured to pal_precommit.txt, OR a SKIPPED-with-reason marker captured to the same file.
Verdict is SAFE TO COMMIT (or SKIPPED documented).

steps.task: Author SERIES_VERIFICATION_REPORT.md: executive verdict (VERIFIED / NOT_VERIFIED / BLOCKED), source artifacts used (PR #709, PR #710, repair PROOF.json, REPAIR_DECISIONS.md), full-suite result (actual totals), print-config result, route-readiness result, CLI-import result, remaining xfails and follow-up packets (TP-RTE-WALKER-006 for Cluster D), and — if NOT_VERIFIED — exact blockers.
validation: Report explicitly states VERIFIED, NOT_VERIFIED, or BLOCKED.
If NOT_VERIFIED, names the follow-up TP(s) needed.
Lists residual deferred work (TP-RTE-WALKER-006 for Cluster D).

steps.task: Emit PROOF.json + sha256sums.txt referencing all captured artifacts. PROOF.json fields: packet_id, status (VERIFIED/NOT_VERIFIED/BLOCKED), status_scope=`series_gate` (NOT `repair_gate_only_not_series_gate`), base_sha, branch, source_repair_pr (#709), source_index_pr (#710), validation_buckets (PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN), full-suite summary (actual counts), print-config summary, route-readiness summary, CLI-import summary, Cluster D status, live_provider_calls=NOT_RUN, live_extraction=NOT_RUN, final conclusion. sha256sums.txt must cover every present file in the proof directory; omit any PAL file that was SKIPPED and note the omission in PROOF.json.
validation: PROOF.json parses.
PROOF.json status_scope == `series_gate`.
sha256sums.txt verifies all present proof artifacts.

steps.task: Update task-packets/INDEX.md to add a TP-RTE-COSTPROFILE-F-VERIFY-002 row reflecting the verification verdict. Do NOT overwrite F-VERIFY-001 (`NOT_VERIFIED_ACCEPTED_AS_EVIDENCE`) or F-FULLSUITE-REPAIR-001 (`Merged (PR #709)`) history.
validation: F-VERIFY-002 row added with status reflecting the verdict (VERIFIED / NOT_VERIFIED / BLOCKED — or the repo's equivalent status vocabulary).
F-VERIFY-001 row unchanged.
F-FULLSUITE-REPAIR-001 row unchanged.

steps.task: Commit allowlisted files, push, open PR against main (do not merge). Run `git diff --cached --name-only` and verify every staged path is in the allowlist before committing — unstage anything that leaked.
validation: Every staged file is in the allowlist.
Commit message == `test(rte): verify costprofile f repair`.
PR base == main, head == codex/rte-costprofile-f-verify-002.
PR is OPEN (not merged).
